chunks: And from him, from Salamah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Jubba'i, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb al-Bajali, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Whoever performs the 'Arfah (standing/visiting) at the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), has indeed witnessed 'Arafah.'

key_terms.عَرَفَ: To recognize or perform the ritual standing/visiting (Arfah)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting Imam Husayn's grave compared to Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* elevates Ziyarat al-Husayn to the status of Hajj, reflecting the theological view that the Imam’s shrine serves as a spiritual axis of the earth. Scholars interpret 'recognizing' (ta'rif) not merely as physical presence but as acknowledging the Imam’s divine station, thereby granting the visitor the reward of standing at 'Arafah, the pinnacle of Hajj. This underscores the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia soteriology and ritual practice.
